parts.name: Cap
parts.Basic_description: This is the cap of a pen, typically made of lightweight plastic. It covers the writing tip to prevent ink from drying out.
parts.Functional_description: The cap protects the pen tip and prevents ink leakage or drying. It may also clip onto a pocket or notebook for portability.
parts.Movement_description: It can be removed or attached to the pen body by pulling or snapping into place.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the pen, made of plastic and designed to house the ink refill and provide grip for writing.
parts.Functional_description: The base body holds the ink cartridge and provides the main structure for handling and writing.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the main grip area while writing.
